title: Natural Q&A #2
summary: Personal Q&A: NH introduces himself (French-born, US master's in literature, works in AI, 25, monk-like routine), his channel goals, discipline over motivation, why muscle and confidence help with dating, favorite anime (One Piece, Eyeshield 21's Shin), staying at 210 lb on his recomp, refusal to do vlogs or prep for stage leanness, views on AI coaches, PEDs and dating, and combat sports.
claims: Q&A frequency: hypertrophy Q&A becomes monthly, injury Q&A maybe every two months, nutrition every three
I like work, reading and lifting; I used to do swimming and running but now only lift
I live where winter lasts eight months with no sun
I hate liars and hypocrites and people who take themselves too seriously to laugh at themselves
My dreams: own a large piece of land, push my body's limits, and help build a world where people teach each other
Top of my class growing up; double bachelor's in communication and modern literature, then a master's in the US in an applied literature/linguistics field; I work in AI; born in France
The channel's main goal is building a community of natural lifters who push limits and help each other
Vlogs are lazy content that promote living vicariously; I will not make them beyond maybe cheap cooking videos
Training is discipline, not motivation: 5 to 8 pm is training time, no questions asked
For a spark I use music, plus anime and manga, which got me into lifting through muscular characters
My biggest life mistake was falling out of love with things, always my fault; I will not let it happen again
Getting muscular makes you more attractive physically and signals health, competence, work ethic and high testosterone
Lifting raises confidence, posture and hormones; neediness and desperation repel, especially women
Muscle is only a boost; you also need personality to match
I prefer to train alone; Guts, Zoro and Shin train alone too; Yamato from Eyeshield 21 would be fun because he would try to kill you in the gym
Eyeshield 21 is a top-three sports manga; read it, the anime is awful
Still 210 lb; the recomp lost fat (core first) without weight loss, and back and legs will take longer
I barely train quads or biceps because they are already big; upper back gets the most volume, trained every day
Sets per body part is individual; stronger body parts naturally push more tonnage so the biggest volume does not always go to the ones you want to grow
Not Japanese or of Asian descent despite people often assuming so
I would compete in an online show; I will not travel to compete for protein prizes and have no love for the bodybuilding industry
Natural bodybuilding standards demanding about 8% body fat make men look like skeletons, not a powerful masculine physique
One Piece is the best anime/manga of all time; Hunter x Hunter could have rivaled it if longer
Shin from Eyeshield 21 is my favorite character because we look alike and share a personality
Most AI workout generators are random; advanced ones just redistribute one programmer's expertise and cannot adapt nutrition to individual foods
AI cannot predict beyond what it already knows; learn to program and diet yourself
I comment on many channels for visibility because YouTube does not promote small channels; I do not watch most of them
PEDs raise confidence by boosting hormones, but the change is behavioral, so naturals can achieve it by acting confident
Shy men who start PEDs do better with women mostly because they start trying; for every success story many hide bad side effects
Forum claims cannot be verified; many people lie on forums
I like boxing, MMA and above all grappling: sumo, judo, jiu-jitsu; I practiced judo
I want kids someday; at 25 I am already settled, basically a monk; enjoy your 20s but do not damage your future
